entities.title: Production
entities.summary: The laumufarthegi Worker at icelander.net/games/laumufarthegi*, with its static page and the Room Durable Object namespace.
entities.purpose: The game players reach at icelander.net/games/laumufarthegi/ and the room links they share.
entities.deployedBy: The owner, from their own machine: `npm run deploy` in games/laumufarthegi, with a Cloudflare token for the icelander.net account (or wrangler logged in to it). Nothing deploys from GitHub's runners: the Deploy workflow was removed (the owner's decision, 2026-11-21).
approvals: The owner's decision: nothing deploys on its own, and only the owner runs the deploy.
A pull request, tested by CI, for anything that reaches main: main accepts nothing else.
entities.rollback: No rollback is recorded: deploy the previous commit again with `npm run deploy`, or roll back the Worker's version in Cloudflare's dashboard.
entities.details: The Durable Object class Room is created by the rooms-v1 migration in wrangler.jsonc (new_sqlite_classes) when the Worker first deploys; there is no D1 database, so the database-migration gate has nothing of this game's to check. The topics are bundled at build time from games/word-lists/data/topic-grids.json, so a change there goes live with the game's next deploy.
